title: A plain transfer to a wallet never reaches its implementation
rootCause: The wallet proxy in src/Wallet.sol returns at once on a call with value and no calldata, so the receive function of its implementation never runs, and an implementation that needs to act on incoming money cannot.

poc.observable: test_a_plain_transfer_reaches_the_implementation fails with "what the implementation heard of the transfer: 0 != 1"
